title: P0-5b recover-pending-actions: Reattach pending_actions to action queue after Runtime::recover
description: Feature P0-5b (revision of black-hat-flagged vb-pi2zl; paired with new P0-5a). Black-hat review round 1 found that the original bead cited non-existent file:line references (recover.rs:484 doesn't exist; the file is 296 lines). It also flagged a priority inversion: P0-5 depended on P2-15, but P0 is a higher priority than P2 — work on a P0 bug should not block on a P2 feature. The black-hat recommended splitting P0-5: (a) P0-5a (new bead) does the frame-seed wire-up with no P2-15 dependency; (b) this bead (P0-5b) handles the pending_actions coordination and depends on P2-15. Real source: vb_storage/src/recovery/recover.rs:251-260 (recover_runtime_frame_seed is fully implemented but orphaned); vb_storage/src/recovery/recover.rs:277-296 (recover_all_incomplete_runs returns Summary only, drops frame data); vb_runtime/src/runtime/mod.rs:343-365 (Runtime::recover is gated behind #[cfg(feature = 'test-util')] and only rehydrates a Summary, not the full RunFrame). This bead's specific scope: (1) add a method `recover_pending_actions` to vb_storage that returns the action tickets and idempotency keys that were scheduled but not yet completed; (2) wire Runtime::recover to call this method and re-attach the tickets to the shard's action queue (Shard::pending_actions); (3) ensure the index_status / index_workflow coordination is complete (depends on P2-15 closing vb-yrtka). Master §68 invariants 1-5 apply; Kani harness proves bit-identical rehydration of pending_actions.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL rehydrate pending_actions (action tickets scheduled but not yet completed) from the journal during recovery
THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve the order of pending_actions during recovery (FIFO by ticket seq)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN Runtime::recover is called on a non-terminal run with N pending actions in the journal
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL re-attach N tickets to the shard's action queue, ordered by ticket.seq, and mark them as 'recovered' in the journal

unwanted.condition: IF a pending action's idempotency_key was already completed before the crash
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT re-issue the action; it must mark the ticket as 'idempotent_skip' and emit an audit event
unwanted.because: Master §68 invariant 3: replay is bit-identical; re-issuing a completed action would violate idempotency

preconditions: P0-5a (recover-frame-seed-wire) is complete and the runtime frame is rehydrated
P2-15 (index-status-workflow) is complete and index_status / index_workflow are wired
vb_storage::recovery::recover_pending_actions is the new API this bead adds
postconditions: Runtime::recover attaches all pending_actions to the shard's action queue
Idempotency: tickets with completed idempotency_keys are not re-issued
An audit event (JournalEvent::PendingActionsRecovered { count, idempotent_skips }) is written to the journal
invariants: Recovery is deterministic: same journal → same pending_actions queue (master §68 invariant 4)
The order of pending_actions is preserved by ticket.seq

happy: recover_pending_actions_returns_tickets_in_seq_order: 100 random journals with 0-10 pending tickets; assert the recovered queue is ordered by ticket.seq
runtime_recover_attaches_pending_actions_to_shard_queue: kill a non-terminal run with 3 pending actions; restart; assert Shard::pending_actions.len() == 3
error: recover_with_idempotent_skip_does_not_reissue_completed_actions: journal has 5 actions, 2 completed; recover; assert 3 are queued, 2 marked idempotent_skip
recover_with_empty_pending_actions_succeeds: journal with zero pending actions; recover; assert Shard::pending_actions is empty
edge: proptest_recovery_is_deterministic: 1000 random (journal, restart_cycle) pairs; assert recovered state == previously recovered state
kani_recover_pending_actions_preserves_order: bounded model check with 4 tickets in 4! permutations; assert all 4 orderings produce the same output queue

files: crates/vb_storage/src/recovery/recover.rs:277-296 (recover_all_incomplete_runs — must be extended to also return pending_actions)
patterns: Pattern: existing recover_runtime_frame_seed returns a RecoveryFrameSeed that includes pending_actions. The fix is to add a sibling method recover_pending_actions that returns only the tickets (for the case where the frame is already rehydrated by P0-5a)
questions: Should pending_actions be stored in the same Fjall keyspace as the journal, or a separate pending_actions keyspace? (Recommend: same keyspace, scoped by run_id, to avoid an extra round-trip)

data_integrity_failures.failure: Restart re-issues a completed action, double-spending the side effect (e.g., charging a credit card twice)
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Idempotency check via idempotency_key; completed actions are marked idempotent_skip

security_failures.failure: Attacker crashes the runtime between action scheduling and completion; the action is re-issued but the idempotency_key was forged to bypass the check
security_failures.prevention: Idempotency keys are derived from the action contract hash, not user input
